name: Employee Information Form
text: Columns for personal, job, bank and statutory details — also importable as a staff list.

name: Leave Application Form
text: Leave type, dates, days, reason and approval columns.

name: Attendance Register
text: Monthly register with a column for each day and totals.

name: Salary Structure Template
text: Earnings, deductions and formulas laid out for a structure.

name: Employee Exit Checklist
text: Clearance items from assets to final settlement.

name: Shift Roster Template
text: Employees down the side, dates across, shift codes in cells.

name: Performance Review Template
text: Goals, self rating, manager rating and comments.

name: Offer Letter Template
text: Position, joining date, salary, probation and validity fields for an offer letter.

name: Appointment Letter Template
text: Designation, place of work, salary, notice period and leave terms.

name: Salary Slip Template
text: Earnings, deductions and net pay laid out for a monthly payslip.

name: Full & Final Settlement Checklist
text: Last salary, leave encashment, gratuity, recoveries and letters to issue.
